description: Ben Snell (they/he) is a software engineer and interaction designer with 9 years of experience in generative graphics, computer vision and computational design. Self-starter, versatile, and resourceful, they thrive in collaborative, cross-disciplinary environments, tackling ambiguous problem sets with positive social impact. Recently, Ben was a Senior R&D Software Engineer at Amazon's HumanFX Lab. Before this, they were a Creative Technologist at Local Projects and an Innovator in Residence at Autodesk's Pier 9 fabrication research center. They graduated from Carnegie Mellon University in 2017 with University Honors after defining their own major, Experiential Art and Design. They live and work remotely in Asheville, NC. For work experience, see LinkedIn. Code samples on Github. Resume available here. . . . Website designed + programmed from scratch.
